verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.attio.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with an index of docs pages served as raw .md, so an agent can be pointed straight at it. The App SDK docs are also explicitly agent-oriented: every new app ships with AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, and the SDK is described as designed for AI-assisted development. Missing for 10: no evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-content bundle, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the probed paths.
